desc: This run tests the chain setup with 1024 tokens with Llama-3.1-1B-Instruct with variation.
system_prompt: You are a player in a conversational game with 5 other players. You are {player_name}. The other players are {other_players}. {rules}
rules: Each player has been given a sentence that is part of a short story with five sentences, and the sentences are causally and temporally related to each other. Your goal is to work together to reassemble the original story by determining the correct order of the sentences through discussion and sharing of your individual sentences. The game will end when a player includes 'STOP' in their response.
